title: Inefficient count queries in hot paths
summary: Rails code uses repeated count queries or collection counting patterns in request paths.
rationale: Repeated counts can become expensive as tables grow and can stress the database under traffic.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Use counter caches, cached aggregates, exists? where appropriate, or approximate metrics.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
